info.name: VAST API Swagger Schema activedirectory monitors API

items.docs: This endpoint lists properties of predefined analytics reports.
This endpoint defines a custom analytics report.

info.name: Query Analytics with Ad Hoc Query Parameters

params.name: object_type
params.description: The type of object to monitor.

params.name: from_time
params.description: Start time of report. e.g. 2021-01-15T13:41:52Z

params.name: to_time
params.description: End time of report. e.g. 2021-01-15T13:41:52Z

params.name: time_frame
params.description: Time frame to report. Specify as an integer followed by 'm' (minutes) 'h' (hours), 'D' (days) ,'W' (weeks) or 'M' (months) 'Y' (years). e.g. 10m

params.name: object_ids
params.description: Specify a list of IDs of objects of the specified object_type to filter the report on those specific objects.

params.name: prop_list
params.description: A list of metrics to query. To get the full list of metrics, use GET /metrics/.

params.name: granularity
params.description: Data granularity: seconds (raw), minutes (five minute aggregated samples), hours (hourly aggregated samples), or days (daily aggregated samples)

params.name: aggregation
params.description: If granularity is minutes, hours or days, the data is aggregated. This parameter selects which aggregation function to use.

items.docs: This endpoint queries VMS for analytics.

params.name: key
params.description: Filters results by category of performers. Supported for users, clients and views only.

params.name: type
params.description: Filters results by a specified performance metric

params.name: count
params.description: The maximum number of top performers in each category to return in the response

params.name: timestamp
params.description: The timestamp for which to display data. For example, 2023-12-06T13:10:03Z. If not passed, the most recent sampling is returned.

items.docs: This endpoint queries VMS for top performer data. It can return performance metrics for the most active client users, views, client hosts, vips, vip pools and cnodes.
